status: Placeholder lists and record types, awaiting clinician review (CR-52)
note: Record only. Nothing here raises an alert or sets a result until a clinician writes a rule for it.

kinds.label: ECG (heart tracing)
kinds.how: Take the tracing on the ECG device, then log that it was done. No tracing is kept in this demo.

kinds.label: Heart rate variability
kinds.how: Enter the value your wearable or ECG device reports after a resting recording.

kinds.label: Amsler grid
kinds.how: Hold the screen 30 cm away with your usual glasses on. Cover one eye. Look only at the centre dot.
options: Some lines wavy, blurred or missing

kinds.label: Retinal scan (OCT)
kinds.how: OCT is optical coherence tomography, a scan of the back of the eye. Log that the scan was done. No scan is kept in this demo.

kinds.label: Eye pressure (tonometry)
kinds.how: Enter the reading from the tonometer, one eye at a time.

kinds.label: Visual field test
kinds.how: Log that the test was done. No result is kept in this demo.

kinds.label: White cell count
kinds.how: Enter the result from the blood analyser.

kinds.label: Salivary cortisol
kinds.how: Enter the result from the saliva test, taken at the same time of day each time.

kinds.label: Venous blood gas: pH
kinds.how: Enter the result from the blood gas analyser.

kinds.label: Venous blood gas: lactate
kinds.how: Enter the result from the blood gas analyser.

kinds.label: Pain or stiffness
kinds.how: Tap what it is and where, then how bad it is now.
